reason: The README clearly presents the plugin as a user-facing DeepSeek Harness attachment feature focused on dragging and dropping files/folders into the chat input, persisting them, and making them available in chat sessions, with no evidence that its primary purpose is development, testing, research, or external service integration.

summaries.zh: 该插件面向 DeepSeek Harness 用户，在输入区支持拖拽文件和文件夹并生成附件卡片，在会话内持久化与提交附件内容。
summaries.en: This plugin adds drag-and-drop file and folder attachment support to DeepSeek Harness input, allowing users to attach files via the chat UI and persist/submit them within sessions.

capabilities: Drag-and-drop ingestion of files and directories in the web client
Persisting attachment metadata and attachment payloads in the workspace
Rendering attachment cards in chat input and history
Providing workspace attachment paths for downstream model access
